name: Dikiş Kulübü: a hands-busy mobile lesson
project: A fictional community sewing club offers short Turkish-language lessons in an offline-capable phone page. The fixed fixture is one instruction screen, with no navigation or interaction implementation requested.
audience: New adult sewers using their own phones while handling fabric and thread. Some users have small, older screens and may not be fluent technical readers.
medium: 390 px wide mobile screen, checked at 100% size. It is a task instruction, not a news article or marketing page.
tone: Patient, clear, capable and human. It should feel like a skilled person explaining one practical step. Avoid a childish craft aesthetic or a severe technical manual.
main_task: Read the current action, distinguish the short material list from the three numbered steps, and find the continuation control.
language: Turkish. Preserve dotted capital İ, dotless ı, ş, ğ, ö, ç and ü. Inspect their actual appearance and case distinctions; cmap presence alone is not the complete check.
hierarchy: Club name and progress are quiet; task heading and the continuation control are easy to find; the body should carry the explanation. Distinguish numbered steps without decorative bullets or icons.
surroundings: White content on a soft grey page, dark blue-green text, one pale yellow note, and a dark continuation button. Keep colors, width and block order.
existing_baseline: A neutral regular/bold baseline is provided. It can be retained. No second family is required and a single-family implementation may be simpler and more coherent.
design_freedom: Choose typography and role sizes within title 25–31 px, body 16–19 px, caption 13–15 px, button 17–20 px. Width 390 and padding 22 stay fixed; body leading 1.35–1.6. Do not compress text by using excessive negative tracking or remove supplied copy. Up to two families.
acceptance: All Turkish copy renders from exact chosen faces without fallback or missing glyphs.
The initial task heading is at most three lines, and the continuation label remains at most two lines.
At 390 px there is no horizontal clipping or overlap; the whole screen fits within 1280 px height.
The digit 1, lowercase l, uppercase I, dotted İ and dotless ı are inspected using the supplied short audit string in addition to the composition.
The implementation recipe specifies language tr, exact weights/axes and line heights; retaining the current family is allowed.
audit_text: 1 l I İ ı i — İplik, iğne, ölçü, güç, şaşırma.
